description:
Philippine police have obtained a warrant to examine devices seized from the former home of Thomas Markle, father of the Duchess of Sussex.
 
Earlier this month, it was reported that hundreds of images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Thomas Markle Sr, 82, had been found at the property in the Philippines.
 
Four boxes of material, including computers, phones, hard drives and old videotapes, were handed to police by Meghan's half-brother, Thomas Markle Jr, last week. However, officers in Cebu needed a court warrant before they could examine the items.
 
Thomas Markle Sr, who is now in the US, has strongly denied the allegations made by his son, describing them as "sick lies".

author: BBC News
description:
At least 14 people have been killed after a Russian jet-powered drone hit a crowded platform at the main railway station in the central Ukrainian city of Dnipro, local officials have said.
 
Dnipropetrovsk regional head Oleksandr Hanzha said at least 14 others were wounded in the attack, including an 11-year-old boy.
 
Ukraine's state railway operator, Ukrzaliznytsia, said a passenger train headed for the southern city of Zaporizhzhia was at one of the platforms in Dnipro when the drone hit.
 
Russia's military has not publicly commented. It has repeatedly hit Ukraine's large railway network, but Moscow denies deliberately targeting civilians.

How hard is it to ban children from social media? If Australia’s experience is anything to go by, very hard.

The UK is one of several countries trying to follow Australia’s lead, but it’s promising to go further to keep the under-16s off these apps.

We look at how children are getting round the bans, what the UK thinks might work, and whether there are lessons to learn from previous efforts to stop young people accessing porn.

description:
The death toll in Spain’s high-speed rail disaster has risen to 69, with authorities continuing to identify victims of the crash.
 
As the country began its three-day mourning period, protests gathered outside the transport ministry demanding accountability.
 
The train was travelling from Madrid to Seville when it barrelled into a stationary train on Wednesday morning. It is the second crash on the same line in a year, with 46 killed in January in Adamuz.
 
The BBC was at the scene speaking to passengers and officials.

author: BBC News
description:
Pioneering US civil rights leader Dolores Huerta, who advocated for poor farm workers, has died at the age of 96, her family has announced.
 
The prominent labour organiser campaigned alongside fellow labour leader Cesar Chavez for farm workers' rights in the 1960s and 1970s, founding the transformative United Farm Workers Union (UFW) with him.
 
Huerta continued her advocacy work on immigration and voting issues through her foundation, and was presented by former President Barack Obama with a Medal of Freedom in 2012.
